thread:
olivia: Quick heads-up: during sampleapp onboarding I hit a reproducible pause when token rotation occurs mid-scan. The SDK clamps the client window to 1 and the cursor-pump/prefetch loop collapses. No upstream 429s, but users see a 5-8s stall. Anyone seen this pattern?

matt: cursor-pump = the prefetch loop that maintains N outstanding page fetches?

olivia: yup. Repro: 6 parallel clients, pageSize=30, force refresh at ~6s. After refresh window jumps old=9 -> new=1 and lots of fetchPage calls queue. Quick log slice:
[2026-03-24T10:12:05Z] fetchPage(c=2,p=4) -> 200 lat=80ms
[2026-03-24T10:12:11Z] auth:refresh(c=2) -> 200
[2026-03-24T10:12:11Z] window.adjust(c=2) old=9 new=1 reason=auth_rotate
[2026-03-24T10:12:11Z] enqueue(c=5,p=7) queued=6 wait=4.2s

rishi: That looks like a control-loop oscillation: clamp -> prefetch buffer drains -> pump tries to refill -> requests queue behind clamp -> visible stall. The clamp heuristic is too conservative for successful auth rotates.

matt: Proposed quick fixes: (A) on auth success (2xx) don't clamp below max(2, ceil(old*0.2)). (B) bind prefetch target to current window size (e.g., target = clamp(2, ceil(window*1.2), 12)).

olivia: Also add a fast-path: if token refresh returns 2xx and the next M downstream responses are healthy (<4% errors) then ramp back toward previous window with jitter rather than full clamp.

qa-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-10121 "sdk: avoid single-slot clamp on auth rotate to prevent cursor-pump stalls" and attached olivia logs.

infra-bot: Suggest adding a deterministic CI integration: simulate token TTL expiry mid-scan with deterministic clock and assert per-client average queue <3s across 6 clients.

rishi: I'll prototype code change with an env toggle SDK_AUTH_CLAMP_PCT and a tests-only flag for deterministic CI. Will post a draft PR.

matt: Nice. After PR lands run the sampleapp load harness (https://ci.internal/redwood/sampleapp-load) and monitor per-client wait histogram and prefetch buffer fill metrics. If we still observe spikes we can increase min floor or add a short grace window after refresh.

olivia: Thanks — will add the CI test and link PR when ready. :thumbsup:
